query: select latest.blocked_player_id, snapshot.display_name as "display_name?", target.trainer_name, count(*)::bigint as "count!" from ( select distinct on (player_id, blocked_player_id) player_id, blocked_player_id, kind from player_blocks order by player_id, blocked_player_id, id desc ) latest join players target on target.id = latest.blocked_player_id left join lateral ( select display_name from player_discord_snapshots where player_id = latest.blocked_player_id order by id desc limit 1 ) snapshot on true where latest.kind = 'blocked' group by latest.blocked_player_id, snapshot.display_name, target.trainer_name order by count(*) desc, latest.blocked_player_id
